description: This file contains utility functions and classes for managing dependencies, parameter extraction, validation, and request handling in a FastAPI application. It includes mechanisms to resolve dependencies, handle request parameters, validate and extract request bodies, and manage scope and caching of dependencies.
external_methods: url path and parameter analysis functions

classes.name: ParamDetails
classes.description: A dataclass encapsulating details about a parameter, including its annotation, dependency, and model field.

classes.name: SolvedDependency
classes.description: A dataclass representing the outcome of dependency resolution, including resolved values, errors, and related info.

methods.name: Dependant get_parameterless_sub_dependant(*, depends: params.Depends, path: str)
methods.description: Constructs a Dependant object for dependencies without parameters.

methods.name: Dependant get_flat_dependant( dependant: Dependant, *, skip_repeats: bool = False, visited: Optional[list[DependencyCacheKey]] = None, parent_oauth_scopes: Optional[list[str]] = None, )
methods.description: Flattens nested dependants into a single level, merging their parameters and dependencies.

methods.name: inspect.Signature get_typed_signature(call: Callable[..., Any])
methods.description: Returns a typed inspect.Signature object for a given callable, with parameter annotations evaluated.

methods.name: Dependant get_dependant( *, path: str, call: Callable[..., Any], name: Optional[str] = None, own_oauth_scopes: Optional[list[str]] = None, parent_oauth_scopes: Optional[list[str]] = None, use_cache: bool = True, scope: Union[Literal["function", "request"], None] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a Dependant object for a route, analyzing the call signature and parameters.

methods.name: Optional[bool] add_non_field_param_to_dependency( *, param_name: str, type_annotation: Any, dependant: Dependant )
methods.description: Associates parameters like Request, WebSocket, Response, etc., with a dependant.

methods.name: ParamDetails analyze_param( *, param_name: str, annotation: Any, value: Any, is_path_param: bool, )
methods.description: Analyzes a function parameter's annotation, default, and integration with FastAPI's parameter system.

methods.name: tuple[dict[str,Any],list[Any]] request_params_to_args( fields: Sequence[ModelField], received_params: Union[Mapping[str, Any], QueryParams, Headers], )
methods.description: Converts request parameters into a dictionary of argument values and a list of errors.

methods.name: tuple[dict[str,Any],list[dict[str,Any]]] request_body_to_args( body_fields: list[ModelField], received_body: Optional[Union[dict[str, Any], FormData]], embed_body_fields: bool, )
methods.description: Extracts and validates request body fields into argument dictionaries.

methods.name: SolvedDependency solve_dependencies( *, request: Union[Request, WebSocket], dependant: Dependant, body: Optional[Union[dict[str, Any], FormData]] = None, background_tasks: Optional[StarletteBackgroundTasks] = None, response: Optional[Response] = None, dependency_overrides_provider: Optional[Any] = None, dependency_cache: Optional[dict[DependencyCacheKey, Any]] = None, async_exit_stack: AsyncExitStack, embed_body_fields: bool, )
methods.description: Resolves all dependencies for a given Dependant, handling nested dependencies and scope.

methods.name: Optional[ModelField] get_body_field( *, flat_dependant: Dependant, name: str, embed_body_fields: bool )
methods.description: Returns a ModelField that represents the combined request body for a path operation.
